review_candidates.title: Remote IT Infrastructure & Cloud Project Engineer II
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Intelligent Technical Solutions is seeking a Project Engineer II to plan, implement, and deliver IT infrastructure solutions for clients. You will handle servers, networking, cloud platforms, and endpoint management while contributing to SOPs and knowledge bases. The role requires hands-on deployment, strong communication, and experience working with distributed teams. This position is remote, aligned with PST hours, and targets long-term operational excellence.
